name: Trirealm Rift Hollows
effectText: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 1 card from the top of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Trirealm Rift Hollows" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control no monsters: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can add up to 2 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters with different names to your hand, except "Trirealm Rift Hollows", also you cannot activate non-"Trirealm Rift" cards or effects for the rest of this turn.
